grades.quote: |bcache.lock|Protects allocation of block buffer cache entries|
grades.reason: The passage is only a table of xv6 locks. It says bcache.lock protects allocation of block buffer cache entries and b->lock serializes operations on each buffer. That is loosely related to keeping one buffer per block. It never says why xv6 keeps a single cached buffer per disk block, such as keeping processes' views of the block consistent and synchronized.
